parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The direction of the Internet traffic. Valid values:

- **in**: inbound

- **out**: outbound

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: TrafficType
parameters.description:
The type of traffic to query. Valid values:

- **max** (default): peak traffic

- **avg**: average traffic
